items.title: Greg Caputo interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: Like the Gene Krupa Big Band, Mrs. Krupa is still alive and if you use that name you have to pay up

ctx.x: Are those bands the property of the Goodman estate? Or how do they work that?
Definitely the property of the estates. Like the Gene Krupa Big Band, Mrs. Krupa is still alive and if you use that name you have to pay up, which she’s entitled to. I think it’s justified.
And they have the same arrangements, a lot of the same arrangements that they play?
